name: pushout-spec
description: Quint formal model of the boxer pushout exchange protocol, crash-recovery layer, and convergence liveness

scripts.typecheck: for f in *.qnt; do quint typecheck "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: for f in *.qnt; do quint test "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.sweep: quint run pushout_exchange.qnt --invariant=Safety --max-steps=12 --max-samples=20000 && quint run crash_recovery.qnt --invariant=Safety --max-steps=14 --max-samples=20000 && quint run convergence.qnt --invariant=DepClosed --max-steps=18 --max-samples=20000 && quint run frontier_reconcile.qnt --invariant=Safety --max-steps=14 --max-samples=20000 && quint run erasure_vault.qnt --invariant=Safe --max-steps=12 --max-samples=20000
scripts.theorem: quint run frontier_reconcile.qnt --invariant=FrontierComplete --max-steps=0 --max-samples=1 --seed=0x1 && quint run frontier_reconcile.qnt --invariant=FrontierCompact --max-steps=0 --max-samples=1 --seed=0x1
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify:exchange && npm run verify:crash && npm run verify:vault && npm run verify:frontier && npm run verify:convergence
scripts.findings: sh ./expect_violation.sh '[violation]' quint run pushout_exchange.qnt --invariant=ErasureComplete --max-steps=8 && sh ./expect_violation.sh '[violation]' quint run erasure_dilemma.qnt --invariant=EnvelopeAvailable --max-steps=6 && sh ./expect_violation.sh '[violation]' quint run crash_recovery_unsafe.qnt --invariant=NoCorruption --max-steps=6 && sh ./expect_violation.sh '[violation]' quint run crash_recovery_unsafe_snapshot.qnt --invariant=RecoveryCorrect --max-steps=6 && sh ./expect_violation.sh '[violation]' quint run frontier_reconcile_unsafe.qnt --invariant=HeadsOnlySufficient --max-steps=1 && sh ./expect_violation.sh '[violation]' quint run frontier_reconcile_unsafe.qnt --invariant=FrontierNeedsClosure --max-steps=1
scripts.liveness:nofair: sh ./expect_violation.sh 'Temporal properties were violated' java -cp "${TLA_TOOLS:-$HOME/.tlaplus/tla2tools.jar}" tlc2.TLC -deadlock -cleanup -config convergence_nofair.cfg convergence.tla
scripts.liveness:all: npm run liveness && npm run liveness:nofair
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run sweep && npm run theorem && npm run verify:all && npm run liveness:all
